services.value: R&C Joy, Inc. provides NELAP accredited water and wastewater testing and analysis, including bacteriological testing for drinking water and bacteriological sample analysis for Public Water Systems. It also offers wastewater analysis & consulting for effluent/reclaimed water compliance reporting, including total suspended solids, turbidity, N-NH3, and cBOD/BOD, plus process control data such as pH/DO and microscopic analysis of organisms in aeration basins.
